description: Buy PM (Kellian play money) with USDC on Base. Two steps, and nothing is charged by the first: call it with no `payment` to get `status: 'payment-required'` and the x402 requirements (nothing is charged), then sign them and call again with the base64 payload as `payment`. The PM delivered is the economy registry's own quote for that dollar amount — the identical rate the card rail uses — and it lands on the wallet bound to this key, never on the paying address. PM has no cash value and cannot be redeemed or withdrawn.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload — the value an HTTP caller sends as the X-PAYMENT header. Omit it on the first call to receive the requirements to sign.

usd.description: US dollars to spend. Must equal one of the listed purchase bundles.

name: kellian_buy_play_money
title: Buy play money with USDC on Base (x402)
